item.title: Attorney General Ellison again leads court defense of Temporary Protected Status for immigrants from Somalia
item.description:
Publication Date: October 27, 2026

Leads coalition of 17 AGs in amicus brief asking federal court to hear appeal; second time this year AG Ellison and coalition have supported TPS for Somali Americans

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/10/27_Temporary-Protected-Status.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison sues to block Trump Administration’s gift to fraudsters
item.description:
Publication Date: October 27, 2026

Joins coalition of 20 AGs in lawsuit to block Treasury Department’s gutting of bipartisan Corporate Transparency Act, which requires businesses to disclose who owns and controls them so criminals can’t hide dirty money

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/10/27_Corporate-Transparency-Act.asp
